Class CLIUI

java.lang.Object
CLIUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameListener, TicTacToeUI
public class CLIUI extends Object implements TicTacToeUI
A command-line (text-based) user interface for Tic-Tac-Toe. Players enter a number 1-9 to choose a cell, with 1 being top-left and 9 being bottom-right. Implements TicTacToeUI and GameListener to receive and display game events.

    • start

      public void start(TicTacToeGame game, boolean vsAI, Opponent ai, TicTacToeGame.Mark aiPlaysAs)
      Starts the CLI game loop. Registers this object as a game listener, then loops until the game ends, prompting human players and delegating AI turns automatically.
      Specified by:
      start in interface TicTacToeUI
      Parameters:
      game - the game model
      vsAI - whether one player is an AI
      ai - the AI opponent (used only if vsAI is true)
      aiPlaysAs - which mark the AI uses
